description: A 64x64 card, red on its left half and blue on its right, turning about its own vertical axis from 0 to 180 degrees over 33 frames — the page-turn. The compared frames sit on the angles the whole feature is described by: 0 at frame 0, 45 at 8, 90 at 16, 135 at 24 and 180 at 32. Frame 0 is the card face on, red on the left. By 45 it has narrowed to about 71% of its width, still red on the left, with black either side of it — a build that squashed it vertically instead has the axes crossed and fails on the bars. Frame 16 is edge on and must be **entirely black**: at 90 degrees the layer is skipped rather than drawn, and a build that hands a zero-width layer to the rasteriser leaves a line of smeared colour down the middle here. Frames 24 and 32 are the back of the card, mirrored, blue on the left — a build with no negative scale shows red on the left at 180 and fails. The source is asymmetric on purpose: a uniform card is identical to its own mirror and would assert nothing at 180.
